description: This Java source file defines the class DestinationCommandConsumer, which manages AMQP command message consumption for devices and gateways within the Eclipse Hono framework. It handles creation of receivers, command handler registration, message processing, and remote link management, supporting device-specific and gateway-specific command handling scenarios.

classes.name: DestinationCommandConsumer
classes.description: A final class extending CommandConsumer that manages AMQP command message reception, handler registration, and message processing for devices and gateways, supporting remote link management and command handling logic.

methods.name: addDeviceSpecificCommandHandler
methods.description: Registers a command handler for a specific device, optionally associated with a gateway, ensuring no duplicate handlers for the same device.

methods.name: addDeviceSpecificCommandHandler
methods.description: Registers a command handler using a CommandHandlerWrapper, validating device and gateway IDs.

methods.name: handlerIsForConsumerGatewayOrDevice
methods.description: Checks if a handler's device and gateway IDs match the consumer's device or gateway ID.

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Returns true if the receiver link is open and not closed remotely.

methods.name: handleCommandMessage
methods.description: Processes an incoming command message, extracting device ID, selecting the appropriate handler, and handling tracing spans.

methods.name: containsCommandHandler
methods.description: Checks if a command handler exists for a given device ID.

methods.name: getCommandHandlerOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a command handler for a specified device ID or defaults to the consumer's device ID.

methods.name: onRemoteClose
methods.description: Handles remote closure of the receiver link, invoking handlers and closing command handlers.

methods.name: removeHandlerAndCloseConsumerIfEmpty
methods.description: Removes a command handler for a device and closes the consumer if no handlers remain.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new DestinationCommandConsumer with a receiver link, setting up message handling and remote close hooks.
